row.evidence: PagerTree's pricing page lists Single Sign-On (SSO) on the Elite plan ($19/user/mo) and its SSO docs cover SAML 2.0 only; no SCIM endpoint appears anywhere in the pricing page, docs or API reference.
row.notes: Status changed from unknown to none by absence (medium confidence): the pricing page, all 106 pages in the docs sitemap (including the REST API reference) and the Okta catalogue were searched, and none mention SCIM. Prices changed since June: Basic free (up to 5 users), Pro $15/user/mo monthly or $150/user/year (up to 25 users), Elite $19/user/mo or $190/user/year (unlimited users, SSO), Enterprise now Custom (June listed Pro $10, Elite $15, Enterprise $25). Per-user figures use the yearly price divided by 12. Users can be created and removed through the REST API v4 (account_users endpoint, bearer API token scoped to the account), but no IdP connector uses it.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free tier. SSO is listed on the Elite card, not Basic.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: The comparison table marks Single Sign-On (SSO) as included on Elite and Enterprise and not on Basic or Pro. Enterprise adds MSA, DPA and security review. scim false = no SCIM documented on any plan.

scim.notes: available=false by absence: the SSO docs and SSO feature page describe SAML 2.0 only, and no docs page mentions SCIM. PagerTree never states 'no SCIM'.

auth.notes: Bearer API token created per user on the My Settings page and scoped to the account; no scopes documented.

capabilities.notes: Users are removed from an account by deleting the Account User; deleting a User object is not supported. Creating an account user for someone already in PagerTree sends an invite. Teams act as groups. Roles (admin, billing, broadcaster, communicator) are set through the account user roles hash.

endpoints.purpose: Create an account user (adds a user to the account)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Outgoing webhooks carry alert payloads; no user events are documented.

audit_log_api.notes: A Logs API (GET /api/v4/logs) exists, but it documents object movement within the app; it is not described as an audit log.

rate_limits.text: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests is returned when requests come too quickly; exponential backoff recommended. No numeric limit is published. List endpoints page 1-100 objects (default 10).

limitations.text: The API does not support bulk updates; one object per request.
Deleting a User object is not supported; remove the Account User instead.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'pagertree' returns no results; SAML is configured as a custom app.

entra.notes: No Learn tutorial at /entra/identity/saas-apps/pagertree-tutorial (404). PagerTree's SSO docs include Azure (Entra) troubleshooting for a custom SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: Admins add users manually (New User form) or through the REST API. The SSO docs do not say whether users are created on first SSO sign-in.
